The "Data analysis" section explicitly lists the searched modifications: "Variable modifications were set to GlyGly modification of lysine residues, oxidation of methionine residues, and pyroglutamate formation of N-terminal glutamine residues. Carbamidomethyl formation of cysteine residues was set as a fixed modification." The SILAC labels are handled by the "multiplicity" setting in MaxQuant, not as a "modification" in the sense of a PTM or chemical modification searched against the sequence. Furthermore, the candidate value lists the target residue as "(A)" (Alanine), but the text specifies it is a Lysine.
